{{Quote|&hellip;Vamo-Yeigh allows me to work in the Alien Enclave. Outsider faces, outsider materials.|Yana-Ton|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vamo-Yeigh''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]] during the [[Galactic War]] and worked in the [[Alien Enclave]]. Vamo-Yeigh allowed [[Yana-Ton]], the daughter of the teahouse owner [[Bas-Ton]], to work in the Enclave and meet the offworlders who stayed in the Enclave.
